heavy_ledger_entry.description: Morning briefing for 2026-03-28. Overnight sprint summary (Runs 68-75): 8 commits shipped, 5 new Lua modules created, UnifiedServer v2.0 wired to 28 modules. Server layer declared architecturally complete. 4 broken handoff chains recovered. Active Mission: 100% Roblox.

key_concepts.description: UnifiedServer v2.0 boots all 28 server modules from a single entry point. 5 new modules created overnight: EnglishRewardsManager, MonetizationOrchestrator, CosmeticController, MobileInputController, UnifiedServer v2.0.
Runs 71-74 had broken handoff chains (GitHub push OK but Handoff Ledger entries missing). Run 75 recovered all 4 in a single pass. Demonstrates self-healing swarm capability.
All 8 overnight commits were BUILD class, driven by Active Mission (100% Roblox). First overnight cycle achieving 100% product code output with zero canon/vault work.
Top recommendation: UnifiedClient.lua to mirror UnifiedServer.lua pattern. One server boot script + one client boot script = complete game architecture.
127 open backlog items with +17 drift. Trending up. Needs Michael triage session. Flagged in 3+ consecutive briefings.
Full server module taxonomy: Core (4), Rewards (3), Economy (4), Social (4), Progression (3), Cosmetic (3), Systems (5), Infrastructure (2). All wired into UnifiedServer v2.0 boot sequence.
8 runs graded: 2 B-grade (Runs 68-69), 6 A-grade (Runs 70-75). All passed Platform Death Test. Chain breaks did not prevent artifact delivery.
